topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walk the familiar path, boots crunching over leaves that tell the story of every autumn since. There, where I used to play, where I planted a sapling with my own hands, a space yawns open under the sky like a forgotten mouth. The stump speaks in a low, relentless whisper, a truth I don’t want to hear. Around it, my memories circle, a flock of birds driven from their nest. I kick at the dirt, sending clumps flying. How could they? This was more than just a tree; it was a pact, a silent witness to laughter and secrets. Now, it’s a hollow echo, a place where shadows can’t even find a home.
